predictions: 15-8 for a second consecutive week, which is again dangerously close to being my second-worst week of the season. I could use a little help here, people… The number of teams that left their best player (or even two players!) home last week was problematic for someone tasked with predicting stuff, folks! That brings me to 176-84 (67.7% correct) for the season so far, and I'm obviously on a slow decline at the moment. Heck, there are still 6 teams that have fooled me more often that not… Ugh.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Why So Serious? In a pretty amazing five-team B race, only two teams have only 3 losses at this point. And here they are! The winner of this one will sit alone at the top with only two weeks to go. Hump Day has been super difficult for me to figure out to this point… but somehow I actually have a worse record in Serious matches?! Oh, man, I don't know…. Humpers in 1001.

Match #2: (G Div.) Flight Risks @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. This pairing will either determine which team will take 2nd in G (and probably climb to F), or it will completely reinvigorate that race. The Risks need to take this one and hopefully cut into the point deficit by a decent bit. However, I'm kinda thinking We Throw It throws it down a bit, 14-10.

Match #3: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Darty Little Secrets. It might be that Wing is too far ahead for most C teams to be able to catch, but the race for 2nd is a four-team battle royale. This matchup has the current #2 team (Secrets) and the current #4 team (McGavin, who won this pairing seven weeks ago). These teams are so evenly matched, they have the same SCkt, DCkt and 501 records so far! Secrets, 13-11.

Matches #4, #5 and #6: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Death Throw; Dart Knights @ Sofa Kings; That's What She Said @ The Dartifacts. The Dartifacts have managed to open a two-match gap on Death Throw and the Dart Knights. But with the points where they are, and the close nature of many F matches, the races for both 1st and 2nd are probably still on. Those top three each face a dangerous situation tonight… The Dartifacts face the team that just dunked the Knights. The Knights face the team with the best record outside this top trio. And Death Throw faces what I still believe is one of the most dangerous bottom teams in any division (at least when they don't leave their two best players at home). Death Throw barely escapes, 13-11; the Knights handle Sofa, 15-9; The Dartifacts get payback on She Said, 14-10.

Match #7: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Bully for the Element. There is roughly no chance Show Me can catch Bully this season, but Show Me is still very much in the fight for 2nd. And more than that, it's possible this is just the second chapter in what might end up being a pretty long-term A race contender story. Element, 15-9.

Match #8: (D Div.) Darty Sanchez @ One Dart Wonders. While Sanchez was off dumping a match to the last-place team last week, the Wonders were coming within a game of upsetting Sanchez's main competition. Now it's Sanchez's turn to face this dangerous upset possibility to avoid having a losing-streak. Sanchez, 15-9.

Match #9: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Waddle In, Waddle Out. Waddle still gets a shot at the Bottoms, so if they get some upset help in the next two weeks, it could be on. But first they have to take out the team that just flat crushed the Corks. Waddle, 14-10.

Match #10: (F Div.) She-nanigans @ Shark Shooters. This might be the best shot at leaving the removed G team as the only winless team this season. The only problem is that She-nanigans just can't find the formula in 501. Because of that, we'll go Shooters, 14-10.

Match #11: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Off Constantly-Reboot. The Possee took a loss AND a painful penalty two Wednesdays ago. Then they almost lost to a four-win team last week. What they didn't know though, was that the Rangers were making them a gift and the D race was VERY much back on! Possee escapes, 13-11.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:

B Division: Stumble Out 14, Kids 10; Raging Bulls 15, Mafia 9.

E Division: Bottoms Up 16, Bangin The Wire 8; Cheap Shots 14, Rippin Darts 10; Runs with Corks 14, Sharky's Machine 10.
